newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Gerdau SA Q1 net jumps.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Gerdau SA Q1 net jumps.

text.p: Brazil's Gerdau steel group released the following first-quarter 1997 results for its Gerdau SA subsidiary.
Note: All figures are in Brazilian reais and are not adjusted for inflation.
The group also reported Gerdau's net profit per lot of 1,000 shares rose to 0.42 reais in the period compared with 0.39 reais in the same period last year.
In a published statement, Gerdau group said it posted a consolidated first-quarter net profit of 30.2 million reais, up 131.9 percent from 13.04 million reais in the same period last year.
The group, which also includes Metalurgica Gerdau S.A. and Siderurgica S.A., also reported gross sales of 579.4 million reais, up 11.4 percent from 520.4 million reais in 1996's first quarter.

It said Metalurgica Gerdau posted a net profit of 10.3 million reais, or 1.69 per 1,000 shares, in the three-month period versus 5.5 million reais, or 1.13 per 1,000 shares, in the January-March period last year.
Gerdau group also reported Siderurgica Riograndense's first-quarter net profit was 14.2 million reais, or 1.20 reais per 1,000 shares, compared with 8.7 million reais, or 1.07 per 1,000 shares.
Gross sales at Siderurgica Riograndense reached 125.9 million reais compared with 110.3 million reais in the period.
